answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the lotus until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the anchor of the next round. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
